decisions.reason: The antenna direction and minimum keepout from message 842 are already fully recorded by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source constrains connector placement on the integrated-board variant and does not change the separate power board's mechanical form factor.
The candidate governs interboard connector placement in the three-board variant, while the source specifies connector placement for the integrated-board variant.
The source adds physical layout constraints within the existing integrated-board variant without changing which architecture variants exist or their roles.
The source does not alter the existing three-board enclosure's accommodation, mounting, airflow, assembly, or retention requirements.
Integrated-board connector-edge constraints do not change the requirement that all content fit on the separate sensor board.
The source does not change the dimensions or routability constraints of the separate main board.
Antenna orientation and connector placement do not change ESP32 pin coverage, breakout placement, format, purpose, or pitch ambiguity.
The integrated-board connector constraints do not affect the separate power board's layer count or grounding strategy.
The source does not mention or change the reset connector's interface, electrical action, or panel-mounted implementation.
The source groups display connectors, not the distinct light-sensor I2C connector represented by this candidate.
Physical placement of the battery, USB-C, display connectors, and antenna does not change current-monitoring rails or monitoring topology.
